l4744.title: Y-Foundry $LUNA Integration into Y-Foundry Governance
l4744.description:
Proposed by Ray Raspberry, Y-Foundry Contributor

# Summary
Y-Foundry revolutionizes project funding and asset escrow through a trust-less, automated smart contract platform operated by the Y-Foundry community.

Approval of this proposal will provide funding to develop an expanded governance framework on the Y-Foundry platform allowing $LUNA to be used for Y-Foundry DAO governance on Terra. $LUNA holders will be able to participate as members of Y-Foundry using their $LUNA tokens.  
Also included in the proposal is funding is business development support to mentor and on-board 15 projects / proposals through the Y-Foundry Community Support / Funding system on Terra from idea through the development phase.

## Objective
To integrate the LUNA token within the Y-Foundry smart contracts and UI to allow $LUNA to be staked for Y-Foundry governance permissions and for participation of funding proposals on the platform. 

## Funds Breakdown
31,818 LUNA - 2.5 months Smart Contract Refactoring + Testing ($17,500 USD at $0.55 per 1 LUNA)
15,454 LUNA - 2 Month UI/UX Development ($8,500 USD)
13,500 LUNA - On-boarding and promotion support for 15 project proposals

## Methodology

### Token Whitelisting
### Locked LUNA Funding and Governance Mechanism
### Token Pool Monitoring

## Milestones
Milestone details are available on Agora due to limitations of text in on-chain proposal submissions.

## Detailed Summary and Deliverables available on Agora:
https://agora.terra.money/discussion/12187-yfoundry-dao-proposal-luna-integration-into-yfoundry-governance

l4743.title: Confio Funding Halt
l4743.description:
Proposed by Orbital Command

This signaling proposal seeks to suspend the monthly payments directed to Confio, as authorized by Governance Proposal #4723. If approved, the funds, totaling 461,900 $LUNA, will be redirected back to the Terra Community Pool.

It's been determined that neither the core development team at TFL nor any significant builders within the Terra ecosystem require specific assistance from Confio on Cosmwasm or other code-related issues. Furthermore, Confio has not sufficiently acknowledged Terra's funding contributions to date. 

With Terra's current priorities leaning towards ecosystem growth and development, the allocation of public goods funding can be more justified once the ecosystem is stronger.

This proposal embodies the Terra community's intent to evaluate the effectiveness and appropriateness of past funding proposals and aims to enhance governance over future Community Pool funding.

For more details on this proposal, please see our post on Agora: https://agora.terra.money/discussion/12352-confio-funding-halt-signalling-proposal-by-orbital-command

l4739.title: Deploy LUNA to the stLUNA liquidity pool
l4739.description:
This proposal aims to deploy 2.5M LUNA to the stLUNA liquidity pool on Astroport. This LUNA would be stewarded by a multisig of trusted Terra community members, and would not be spent in any way. At any time, Terra governance could pass a signaling proposal to order the LUNA returned.

stLUNA is a key LUNA liquid staking token, with integrations on Cavern and Demex. stLUNA is also stakable on the Alliance chain Carbon, and contingent on this proposal passing will be supported as collateral on Shade, to back the SILK stablecoin. Crucially, stLUNA is a strongly decentralized LUNA LST. As a Cosmos chain with Tendermint consensus, the Stride codebase can only be altered through an open, transparent, decentralized governance process.   

Previously, Terra governance deployed 2.5M LUNA to ampLUNA liquidity pools and 2.5M to bLUNA liquidity pools. By extending the same treatment to stLUNA, governance would level the playing field, and increase the diversity and resilience of the Terra DeFi ecosystem.

https://agora.terra.money/discussion/12174-deploy-luna-to-the-stluna-liquidity-pool

l4737.title: Phoenix Software Upgrade v2.4
l4737.description:
On 30 June 2023, Terra upgraded Pisco (Terra's testnet chain) and incorporated several new and important updates, including:

1. Allow amino messages to be used for signing alliance messages. This change allows Ledger to be used with the alliance module.
2. Fixed an issue with authz not validating messages when executing Exec transactions.
3. Fixed an issue with DonateAllVestingTokensMsg failing when users had dust delegations that could not be undelegated.
4. Fixed an issue with ibc-hooks in which callbacks were not triggering smart contracts as expected.

Following testing, this software upgrade proposal will incorporate these updates into Phoenix-1 (mainnet).

See Agora for full upgrade details, including helpful resources: https://agora.terra.money/discussion/12010-phoenix-software-upgrade-proposal
